name: נחל בן-דור
quote: ממזרחה עובר נחל בן-דור אשר מפריד בינה לבין השכונה הוותיקה תל חנן והשכונה החדשה יותר, גבעת עמוס
note: The stream on the east side of Ben Dor in Nesher: its valley, then the culvert to the drain along the Ben Dor / Giv'at Amos boundary, from where the culvert joins it. The drain above that point (1239848403, 1239848402, 1238895193; origin unknown in OSM) is left out. Then about 630 m with no line across the Tel Hanan industrial area, directly north, and the channel to 904193394, an unnamed river channel that reaches the Kishon about 260 m later and is left unnamed.
